sources.title: SiliconFlow official Chat Completions API
sources.applied: Fixed HTTPS endpoint https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1/chat/completions; Bearer authentication; messages/model; bounded max_tokens; stream:false; enable_thinking:false. The example uses deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash. No arbitrary client endpoint or silent model substitution.

sources.title: SiliconFlow official List Models API
sources.applied: Authenticated GET https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1/models?sub_type=chat returns model information. No automatic availability probe is implemented; the parent task may explicitly verify the user's exact model with the user's consent. This listing is not a clinical validation or a successful generation test.

sources.title: SiliconFlow official model centre
sources.applied: Public official catalogue explicitly lists deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. This supports the exact model name; individual account access and live generation remain unverified by backend mock tests.

sources.title: 硅基流动上线高速版 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
sources.applied: Official release announcement confirms SiliconFlow deployment of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; prior DeepSeek generations also remain offered. Model marketing claims are not treated as validation of this teaching application.

developmentBoundary.note: The root agent owns any later user-authorized availability lookup or live test; those results must be separately recorded without credentials.
